jobs.title: BRIM FICA Configurator
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose** 




 The BRIM FICA Configurator is responsible for configuring and supporting SAP Billing \& Revenue Innovation Management with a focus on Contract Accounts Receivable and Payables (FI\-CA). This role ensures that subscription billing, invoicing, payments, dunning, and financial posting flows operate reliably across CI/CM/CC and into S/4HANA Finance.
 



 The position is critical to stabilizing revenue processing, reducing billing defects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Configure BRIM \+ FI\-CA components including business partners, contract accounts, payment processing, invoicing, dunning \& collections
 



 • Maintain and optimize integration flows between Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Mediation (CM), CI, FICA, and S/4 FI postings
 



 • Support month\-end billing cycles, payment jobs, clearing, returns, disputes, and settlement processing
 



 • Troubleshoot billing failures, posting errors, invoicing discrepancies, and CI\-to\-FICA integration issues
 



 • Partner closely with Finance on posting rules, account setup, and revenue recognition dependencies
 



 • Collaborate with BRIM Technical Specialist for enhancements, extensions, and performance tuning
 



 • Ensure billing accuracy and reduce revenue leakage through configuration improvements
 



 • Participate in defect triage, UAT support, regression testing, and automation readiness
 



  





**Skills \& Experience Requirements** 




 • 5\+ years experience in SAP BRIM and FI\-CA configuration (payment processing, dunning, clearing rules)
 



 • Strong understanding of CI, CM, CC integration flows and invoice processing behavior
 



 • Knowledge of Finance postings, FI document flow, revenue settlement, and account determination
 



 • Ability to analyze billing defects and resolve CI/FICA failures with root\-cause accuracy
 



 • Experience supporting high\-volume billing environments preferred
 



 • Clear communicator — able to work with both Finance users \& technical engineering teams
 



 Certification
 



 SAP BRIM Certified (Must have)

jobs.title: SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) Consultant
jobs.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/28/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Design, configure, and implement SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) solutions to support end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash and billing processes on S/4HANA Public Cloud BRIM.  

  

  

Build and maintain integration interfaces between S/4HANA Public Cloud BRIM and client's upstream legacy systems for usage data collection, transformation, validation, and rating.  

  

  

Develop and manage integrations between S/4HANA Public Cloud BRIM and Subscription Billing systems to enable seamless order, contract, and billing data exchange.  

  

  

Configure and support integration between S/4HANA Public Cloud and third\-party Payment Service Providers (PSPs) using the Digital Payments Addon for payment processing, tokenization, and settlement.  

  

  

Design mediation processes, chains, and data flows (streams, sources, transformers, storage points) within SAP Convergent Mediation to handle high\-volume usage and transaction data.  

  

  

Collaborate with functional and technical teams (BRIM/CI, Subscription Order Management, Subscription Billing, FI\-CA) to gather integration requirements and translate them into CM design specifications.  

  

  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data mediation, transformation errors, interface failures, and payment gateway integration.  

  

  

Work closely with client's upstream/downstream application teams and PSP vendors to ensure smooth interface testing, cutover, and go\-live activities.  

  

  

Prepare technical design documents, interface specifications, unit/integration test scripts, and support documentation.  

  

  

Participate in performance tuning, monitoring, and optimization of CM mediation processes to ensure scalability and reliability.  

  

  

Support system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), cutover planning, and hypercare/post\-go\-live support.  

  

  

Ensure adherence to SAP best practices, security guidelines, and data privacy requirements across all integrations.

 BRIM Technical Architect

**Job ID:** 
 r20850
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
 Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross\-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade\-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.
   

  

 Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.
   

  

**Main Missions:**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross\-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI\-CA) within the O2C flow
* Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level.
